title: Dockerfile lint (hadolint)
summary: Lints all Dockerfiles with hadolint; promotes pin/tag hygiene rules to errors.
notes: Promotes DL3007 (no floating tags like :latest/:alpine), DL3008 (pin apt packages), and friends to error — these are the supply-chain / drift bug-classes a container-CVE monitor exists to prevent. Other rules stay at hadolint's default until they prove their value.
